items.title: Folders are channels
items.text: A folder has **effects, pan, fader, M and S**, in the mixer, the inspector and the timeline. Its solo plays only its tracks, and its sends can be taken before the fader (PRE).

items.title: Tool keys in order
items.text: Keys **1 to 9** pick the tools in the order of their buttons: Select, Pencil, Brush, Range, Split, Erase, Listen, Zoom and Hand.

items.title: Interface size in px
items.text: In **Settings → Appearance**, the size is picked with a slider, in half-pixel steps. **Ctrl +** and **Ctrl −** change it from anywhere; **Ctrl 0** goes back to 100 %.

items.title: Note notation
items.text: Right-click the piano roll's keys → **Do, Re, Mi** or **C, D, E**. It applies to the whole app.

items.title: Duplicate tracks
items.text: Right-click a track (or several picked ones) → **Duplicate track** copies it below with its clips and automation, or **Duplicate without content**, only its sound. Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+D.

items.title: Trash can in the inspector
items.text: Each effect and send in the inspector has a **trash can** on its right to remove it in one click. The Effects, Sends and Output titles are bigger.

items.title: Space always goes to the transport
items.text: In the library, **Space** no longer plays the sample: it always starts or stops the song. What the library is playing stops when you click elsewhere in the window or press play.

items.title: A tidier piano roll
items.text: The piano roll's bar has fewer buttons: **Pattern** holds the length and the instruments, the **Snap** has the grid and **View** the shortcuts. At the bottom, always at hand, Draw, Paint, Slice and **Chords**, and **Expression** with its dropdown to pick velocity, mod X, mod Y, pan or release. In a small window it wraps without overlapping.

items.title: More to pick in Appearance
items.text: In **Settings → Appearance**, besides the knobs: the style of **faders**, **meters** and **waveforms**, the interface's **font**, the **numbers'** font (also a 14-segment digital one and Orbitron) and the **size**, in every window. It shows as you pick, and each has its **Reset**.

items.title: Keys to plugin
items.text: A plugin window's bar has a single button, **Keys to plugin**. On, every key goes to the plugin while its window is in front. Off, every key goes to XTreme: transport, shortcuts and the virtual keyboard, effect windows included.

items.title: Mono, stereo or mixed
items.text: Each audio track says next to its name whether its clips are **Mono**, **Stereo** or **Mixed**, and so does the inspector. **Show left and right** shows each side's wave; **L R**, at the foot of the tracks, does it on all of them at once.

items.title: Cut audio
items.text: **Cut audio**, in the transport (or {key:cutAudio}), stops and silences reverb and delay tails and notes left sounding, right away.

items.title: Live keys in the piano roll
items.text: What you play on a **MIDI keyboard** or the **virtual keyboard** lights up on the **piano roll**'s keyboard and along its row, and fades out when you let go.

items.title: Linked files apart
items.text: In the **Library**, **Unlink unused** takes unused linked files out of the project and leaves them where they are. **Delete unused** sends only the project's own files to the Recycle Bin.

items.title: Use, where you are
items.text: **Use** in the **Library** puts the channel on the selected track, at the playhead. With no track selected, or that stretch taken, it goes to a new track.

items.title: Effect tails on stop
items.text: On stop, a **Reverb** or **Delay** in a channel slot rings on until it dies out, as on a bus.

items.title: Lighter reverb
items.text: **Reverb** spreads its work over each block: no more spikes that make audio drop out at small buffer sizes, and the **DSP** tooltip shows which track and instrument take the most load.

items.title: Buttons without tooltips
items.text: In the **mixer**, the **piano roll** and **Mastering**, buttons no longer show a tooltip.

items.title: Several samples at once
items.text: In **Library → Samples**, pick several with **Ctrl** or **Shift**. Dragged together they land one under the other, with a ghost per file while you carry them; when there aren't enough tracks, new ones are made.

items.title: Plugin keys, your choice
items.text: A plugin window's bar adds **Keys to plugin** and **Keys to XTreme**: they send every key to one side, for when the plugin won't let them through or loses too many. Off, as before.

items.title: Resizable mixer sections
items.text: **Effects** and **Sends**, above the mixer, show or hide that section on every strip. Drag the line under each list to make it taller; a double click fits it to the longest list, and the height is remembered.

items.title: Piano roll in key
items.text: With a **scale** picked, the piano roll shows only its rows and keys. Notes already off the scale stay, each on its own row.

items.title: New inspector
items.text: The inspector is now in sections: the track, the selected clip and, at the bottom, the strip with the fader, pan, M and S, the effects, the sends and the output. Values are compact rows you drag. Show or hide the clip and the strip from the top, and drag the strip's edge to resize it.

items.title: No redundant view button
items.text: Without video the timeline is always on screen, so the transport's **Timeline** button is hidden: press **Mixer**, **Piano roll** or **Mastering** again to close them.

items.title: Effects on at a glance
items.text: Each effect's **ON** button glows while it is on. The **Mastering** window resizes without flickering.

items.title: Fewer tooltips
items.text: Knobs, faders, pan, effect graphs, sampler waveforms and dividers no longer pop up a tooltip on hover, so nothing covers what you are about to grab. What a knob does shows over its name.

items.title: Clearer Library
items.text: In the **Library**, each channel's tags sit in their own box under the name and light up while the channel is in the timeline.

items.title: All your projects
items.text: **Projects** shows every project you made or opened, in whatever folder it is, with its path under the name.

items.title: Pump redesigned
items.text: **Pump** has a new panel: the big curve over the sound, one-click shapes and the division on top. With **Sidechain**, its knobs are a compressor's: Threshold, Attack, Hold and Release.

items.title: Knob styles
items.text: Ten styles for the knobs, from Soft to Bakelite, in **Settings → Appearance** (formerly View).

items.title: The gear is back
items.text: Settings opens again from the gear in the title bar. It is still in **File** too.

items.title: Plugins by maker, category or list
items.text: In **Settings → Plugins**, **Show in menus** groups instruments and effects by maker, by category or in one list. The category is detected on its own and each plugin can move to another one or a new one.

items.title: MIDI track with instrument
items.text: **New track → MIDI track with instrument** lists the native and VST instruments: the new track already plays with the one you pick and takes its name.

items.title: Compression graph
items.text: Every compressor shows its curve in its panel, where the signal is, and the last seconds of input, output and reduction.

items.title: Granular
items.text: A new instrument under **Instrument**: it plays a sample in grains. **Stretch** changes the length without changing the pitch; **Scrub** freezes it at a point you can automate.

items.title: Tempo-synced VST effects
items.text: VST effects that follow the tempo, such as a sidechain ducker, now land on the beat: they used to not know where in the song they were.

items.title: Sidechain
items.text: The compressor, the gate and Pump can react to another track: pick it in **Sidechain**, for example the kick so the bass ducks.

items.title: Automation shapes
items.text: Right-click a point or a segment of a lane to pick its shape: curve, double curve, hold, stairs, smooth stairs, pulse or wave, each with its tension. Curves are now more even.

items.title: Classic compressors
items.text: Five new compressors in **+ Effect** → **Classic compressors**: FET, Opto, Bus VCA, Classic VCA and Vari-Mu, each with its own character.

items.title: Pump
items.text: A new effect in **Dynamics**: ducks the volume on every beat, like a sidechain to the kick, locked to the tempo.

items.title: Samples into plugins
items.text: Drag a sample from the Library onto a plugin's window (a sampler, a drum machine) and it loads it as from the Explorer.

items.title: Panels in their own window
items.text: Channel, video, timeline, mixer, piano roll, mastering and Project can each go to a window of their own, with its taskbar button, on another monitor for instance, and come back as they were. Also from View → Panels in windows.

items.title: New Mastering view
items.text: The master chain is laid out as tiles, in the order it sounds; the effect you click is edited below, larger. The Target sits at the top, and on the right the LUFS of the last 30 s. The master's power button turns the whole chain off, Soft clip and Limiter included. Looks and Suggest are gone.

items.title: Duplicate follows the magnet
items.text: With the magnet on, {key:duplicate} puts the copy on the magnet's next whole step, so repeats stay on the grid.

items.title: Edit several clips at once
items.text: With several clips marked, dragging an edge, a fade or the loop of one changes them all the same way.

items.title: Start in an empty project
items.text: Turn off **Show at startup** in Projects and XTreme opens straight in a new project. **Save** asks where it goes. Also in Settings → Saving and export.

items.title: Menu bar
items.text: File, Edit, Track, View, Transport, Tools and Help, at the top left, with each action's key beside it. Settings, Help, What's new and Send feedback are there.

items.title: Messages right away
items.text: The bell is gone: errors and what couldn't be done show as a notice at the bottom right.

items.title: Discard asks first
items.text: While recording, Discard sits apart from Stop and asks for a second click before throwing the recording away.

items.title: Your keys, everywhere
items.text: Menus, the piano roll help and the empty track show the keys from Settings → Keyboard shortcuts, not the default ones.

items.title: More consistent menus
items.text: In the video, Lock, each send and the lane's **Active** have a check: right-click changes them without closing the menu. MIDI tracks get Lock and Apply template, audio tracks **Input…** and folders **Sends**. Removing a track asks first, also from the menu and with Delete.

items.title: Consistent dialogs
items.text: Cancel always sits on the right, next to the main button, and notices (an error, a file that already exists) look the same in every dialog.

items.title: Nothing overlaps in small windows
items.text: The transport, the mixer header and the format bar move a group down a row when they don't fit, and the tools trim the project name before covering Export.

items.title: Mute that stands apart from the accent
items.text: With a warm accent (Fire, Orange, Amber, Gold) mute turns blue, and with a green one (Lime, Green, Emerald) the tuner shows “in tune” in cyan.

items.title: Linked files are never deleted
items.text: Removing a linked channel from the Library takes it out of the project without asking and without touching your file; **Delete unused** only sends what is inside the project to the Recycle Bin.

items.title: Sampler loops without clicks
items.text: The seam always blends, even with **Crossfade** at 0 or a loop that starts at the beginning of the sample, and the level neither dips nor swells at the turn. Ping-pong turns are smooth too.

items.title: Easier chords
items.text: Inversions no longer push the chord up: each one stays close to where it was. {wheel:wheelHeight} over a chord, or over the one you are about to write, changes the inversion. The piano roll bar groups its buttons into **Edit**, **Harmony**, **Grid** and **View**, with **Shortcuts** at hand.

items.title: Mix and effects of a MIDI track
items.text: A MIDI track's inspector shows, under its instrument, its **Mix**, its effects and its sends, like any track.

items.title: Snap and grid with the same values
items.text: The snap, the ruler and the piano roll share one list: Bar, 1/2 to 1/64, triplets (1/2T to 1/32T) and dotted values (1/2D to 1/16D), which start at each bar.

items.title: Range, markers and chords
items.text: The range and the markers each have their own strip, and each strip can be shown or hidden. Double-click the range strip to clear it. The chords strip shows even without chords: double-click it to write one, and drag to move or stretch them.

items.title: Save as
items.text: Save a project in any folder with Save as or Save a copy, and open it from wherever it is with Open. The project file is now Name.xtp; older projects, WildTrack ones included, are converted when you open them.

items.title: Looped clips
items.text: Drag the top right corner of a take, a MIDI clip or an automation block and it repeats up to where you let go. Each repeat carries the loop icon.

items.title: Pencil and brush on the timeline
items.text: Pick a clip, a pattern or a sample and place it with a click of the pencil, or repeat it along a stretch with the brush. A sample can also be dragged from the Library player. The mixer no longer squashes the faders when you make it smaller.

items.title: Tools on MIDI clips
items.text: Split, Delete, Listen and Range now work on MIDI clips. Right-click and drag over clips to delete them, with any tool. Splitting doesn't change what sounds. Piano roll notes go through the track's effects.

items.title: Linked files
items.text: Copy a linked take into the project from the Library. If a file moved, choose it or search a folder and its clips play again.

items.title: Safer MIDI takes
items.text: Notes are written to disk as you record. If the program shuts down suddenly, they come back when you open the project.

items.title: Steadier VST effects and instruments
items.text: An effect that runs late no longer cuts out: it plays one block later. In a loop, an instrument's first beat of each lap lands right on A. The picture and the playhead follow what you hear even with a high-latency plugin, and a plugin that falls behind no longer shifts a take.

items.title: New project format
items.text: Projects are saved as xtreme_project.json. Projects and settings from earlier versions no longer open.

items.title: Piano roll tools
items.text: Arpeggiate, strum, chop, Riff Machine, chord progressions, advanced quantize, groove and more, with the result playing as you move the values.

items.title: Slides and per-note expression
items.text: Each note can slide and have portamento, pan, release and modulation. Double-click the note.

items.title: .mid files and score
items.text: Import and export .mid, and get the clip as a PDF on staves.

items.title: Several instruments in a pattern
items.text: Add instruments to a pattern from the piano roll: each goes on its own track, and the others' notes show behind as ghost notes. On the timeline, a line joins the clips that play together.

items.title: Click-free loops in the Sampler
items.text: Zoom the wave down to each sample with the wheel. Snap to zero leaves the flags where the wave crosses zero.

items.title: Sampler
items.text: Drag a sound onto a MIDI track and play it across the keyboard. It detects its note and tunes it, with loop, envelopes, filters and LFO. It hears each note's slide and pan, and its knobs can be automated.

items.title: Maximize a panel
items.text: Enter gives the whole window to the panel you're using: video, timeline, piano roll, mixer or mastering. Enter again and everything goes back as it was.

items.title: Keys from other DAWs
items.text: In Settings → Keyboard shortcuts, switch to the keys of Cubase, Logic Pro, FL Studio, Reaper or Studio Pro with one click.

items.title: Copy or link on import
items.text: When importing, choose whether the file is copied into the project or used where it is, without duplicating it. Also in Settings.

items.title: Scale from the plugin
items.text: The virtual keyboard's scale and chords can now be chosen in the plugin's window too.

items.title: Keyboard in its own window
items.text: Move the virtual keyboard to a separate window with the button at the end of its settings.

items.title: Plugin thumbnails
items.text: Each plugin takes its thumbnail the first time you open its window. It shows in Settings and when you hover over the plugin menus.

items.title: Close the active view
items.text: Press Piano roll, Mixer or Mastering again to go back to the timeline.

items.title: Instruments stay silent on opening
items.text: A newly opened instrument no longer sounds until you play it.

items.title: Send feedback
items.text: Report a bug or suggest something from the title bar: you write the report in the app and send it from GitHub.

items.title: Scales and chords
items.text: Choose the song's scale in the piano roll or on the virtual keyboard: notes land in the scale and you write chords with one click, with their inversions.

items.title: VST2 and 32-bit plugins
items.text: Besides 64-bit VST3, VST2 and 32-bit plugins now open too. The menus mark which ones they are.

items.title: Automate from the plugin
items.text: Click **Automate** in its window's bar and move a parameter: its lane is created.

items.title: Edit several tracks at once
items.text: With several tracks picked, the inspector changes what they share and right-click acts on all of them.

items.title: Stretch a clip
items.text: **Ctrl** + dragging the trim handle stretches it without changing the pitch. Attacks stay in place, so it works on rhythm loops.

items.title: Changing the tempo asks what to do
items.text: Choose **Stretch** the clips or **Grid only**.

items.title: Pitch per clip
items.text: Right-click a clip → **Pitch**: −12 to +12 semitones, added to the track's.

items.title: 96 compressor presets
items.text: By instrument and by use, in 12 categories. **Analyze take** fits them to the recorded level.

items.title: Snap and shortcuts for faster editing
items.text: The snap has **Line**, **Cell** and more divisions. **Shift** + drag copies a clip, {key:alignGrid} aligns it to the grid, {key:selectAll} marks everything and {key:deselect} clears the selection.

items.title: New track, no fixed bar
items.text: The **+** sits at the foot of the track headers, and right-clicking the empty timeline area opens the same menu.

items.title: The loop turns without cuts
items.text: It wraps on the exact sample: the start comes in whole and the click keeps its beat.

items.title: New faders and knobs
items.text: Faders, knobs and mixer with more contrast, the selected track with a colored border, and a refreshed icon.

items.title: Refreshed help and this window
items.text: Topics with icons, the most searched at hand, and each version's changes always one click away on {icon:E789}.

items.title: Automation
items.text: Volume, pan, sends and effect and instrument parameters, on lanes below each track.

items.title: Split into stems
items.text: Vocals, drums, bass and more, each on its own track. It uses the video card if there is a compatible one.

items.title: Patterns
items.text: Linked MIDI clips: editing one changes them all. With their own tab to drag them onto tracks.

items.title: Everything follows the tempo
items.text: Changing the BPM changes the song's speed, keeping the pitch: clips, automation, markers and loop stay on their bar.

items.title: Detect scale and chords
items.text: Right-click an audio clip. Chords can stay on a strip of the timeline.

items.title: More effects
items.text: Chorus, Flanger, Phaser and Tremolo, a 7-band dynamic EQ, and the master's effects on any channel.

items.title: Modular mastering
items.text: The master chain is a list of modules you drag to change the order.

items.title: Reverse a clip
items.text: It plays backwards without touching the file.

items.title: Sample library
items.text: Your sound folders, with search, favorites and preview. Importing is much faster and takes almost any format.

items.title: Help inside the app
items.text: Topics by category, with search. Open it with {key:help}.

items.title: Optional components
items.text: FFmpeg and the stem models install from the app, in **Settings → Components**.

items.title: Now called XTreme
items.text: New name and icon. Your projects and settings stay where they were.
